sources.text:
THE TENANT MUST NOT DISCLOSE CUSTOMER DATA UNLESS THE CUSTOMER HAS GIVEN WRITTEN CONSENT.
The requirements for sellers and for buyers are clear.
Tenant may occupy unless rent is not due, and only if the permit remains valid.

The grant requires documented costs and a reconciled ledger.
The accountant must not post a duplicate payment.
If the invoice is unpaid, the ledger shall retain an exception.
Debit balances and credit balances must reconcile.
The Montréal office shall retain receipts until the audit is complete.
